scripts.dev: npm run build:cards && vite build && wrangler dev
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:cards && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy: npm run build:cards && vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.pretest: npm run build:cards && vite build --logLevel warn

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Access team domain, e.g. `myteam.cloudflareaccess.com`. Turn on Access for the Worker after it deploys (Settings → Domains & Routes → workers.dev → Enable Cloudflare Access) and set this then; until both Access values are set, every API call answers 401. Enter `pending` for now.

ACCESS_AUD.description: The Access application's **AUD tag**, shown once Access is on for the Worker. Enter `pending` for now and replace it after deploying.

USDA_API_KEY.description: Free key from [USDA FoodData Central](https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/api-key-signup). `DEMO_KEY` works for a quick try but is rate-limited.

AI_GATEWAY_ID.description: AI Gateway that every Workers AI call goes through. `default` is created for you on first use; any other name must exist first.
